description: A standing rule given before a reload still applies after it

steps.send: A rule for this chat: every Python file you create must start with the exact line `# owner: team-heron`. Now create hello.py that prints hello.
Create bye.py that prints bye. Follow the rule I gave you earlier.

graders.name: hello.py header
graders.run: head -1 hello.py | grep -qx '# owner: team-heron' && python3 hello.py | grep -qi hello

graders.name: bye.py header
graders.run: head -1 bye.py | grep -qx '# owner: team-heron' && python3 bye.py | grep -qi bye
